liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (4 reviews): China Cat into Rider is called outstanding, with the transition handled flawlessly; Reviewer treats this China Cat>Rider as a rarity worth downloading the show for [18][19][22][25]
- **Comes A Time** (2 reviews): Jerry struggles a little with Comes A Time but plays a cool solo; Phil brakes hard in the segue from Stranger into Comes A Time; the reading itself is gorgeous [25][26]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Estimated Prophet has notably strong guitar playing, which the reviewer credits to Jerry (nicknamed Tiger); A smooth wah-wah exit leads from Comes A Time into Estimated Prophet [18][26]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): The Minglewood opener is rowdy, with an energized Jerry, setting the tone for the night [20]
- **Uncle Johns Band** (1 review): The crowd erupts as Uncle John's Band follows He's Gone [18]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Sugar Magnolia is singled out as a romping version, alongside Uncle John's and He's Gone [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mexical Blues**: back after 525 archived shows (3069 days); rare: 5 archived performances [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-05-10.132518.aud.nak700.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd80-05-10.rolfe.vernon.18158.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 173 min; rated 4.4/5 by 20 [4]. Said about its sound: Loud but unrefined audience recording; Garcia's voice sounds distant, holding the tape to three stars; Sound judged quite good after some EQ adjustment; Recording is natural and full, with plenty of bass [19][20][24]
- **gd1980-05-10.aud.wise.83063.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 173 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [5]. Said about its sound: Excellent transfer, free of the He's Gone dropouts heard on 7559, and a major quality improvement [5]
- **gd1980-05-10.aud.willy.7559.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 172 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Dropouts occur in He's Gone around 11:26 to 11:31, plus a cut between disc two and three [6]
- **gd1980-05-10.152806.senn.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 175 min [7]

## Around the show

- Firecrackers kept going off; the Hartford crowd was fired up and the energy spread to the band [20]
- M80 explosions went off sporadically throughout the show [27]
- Loud bangs, likely firecrackers, sounded during the show and the crowd booed them [6]
- Judged the best show of the spring 1980 East Coast run [22]
- Comes A Time was last played 2-9-79, making its return here [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-05-10.132518.aud.nak700.flac16**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise; source: flac16/48kHz ; Cassette Audience Master recorded By Jim Wise (patched out of Jeff Hellman); Nakamichi CM-700 Electret Condenser Microphones w/ CP-4 Shotgun… [1]
- **gd80-05-10.rolfe.vernon.18158.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; source: Audience Recording: Nak 700's [4]. Also: Reviewer doubts this is the master tape, believing it has been copied many generations [22]
- **gd1980-05-10.aud.wise.83063.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Three Nakamichi CM-300's > patched thru Nakamichi 550 > Sony TC-D5 [5]. Also: Mics were on a stand next to the soundboard; this is an improved transfer from the same master as ShnID-7559; Set two tape flips are patched using Steve Rolfe's tape (ShnID-18158), making the set seamless [5]
- **gd1980-05-10.aud.willy.7559.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Willy; source: Nak 300's > Sony D5 [6]
- **gd1980-05-10.152806.senn.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by Rob Eaton; transferred by Mastered by Scott Clugston April 2021; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2)Sennheiser 441 mics (Left + Right) + (1) Sennheiser 421 mic (Center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [7]. Also: Rob Eaton made the master recording; Nakamichi 700 source patches gaps in Estimated Prophet, Drums and Alabama Getaway [7]
